title: Plenty Vaporizer Complete Set (taxes extra)
description:
Plenty Vaporizer Complete Set

SOLD OUT, WE AREN’T EXPECTING TO GET MORE

RECOMMEND ARIZER XQ2

The Plenty Vaporizer is a powerful and robust corded vaporizer.
It has a huge bowl and produces a lot of vapor.

The heater is equipped with a double helix to ensure efficient heating of the air and high yield vaporization. The highly efficient stainless steel cooling coil ensures a pleasant aromatic experience.

Complete Set includes:
1* Plenty hot air generator
1* Filling Chamber
1* Mouthpiece
1* Cooling Coil
3* Normal Screens
1* Pad
2* Short Tubes
2* Long Tubes
1* Cleaning Brush
1* Storz & Bickel Grinder
1* Instructions
3 Year Warranty
